_comment: Live models whose cached manufacturer document (a source the database already cites) states a circuit or breaker that the database has NOT extracted. The tool never shows these values: it shows that the record does not include them yet and links the document. Found by scripts/electrical_source_scan.py (docs/electrical/r1/source-scan-breaker-awg.json). Remove an entry when the database round extracts the value. Only models that would otherwise read 'not stated' are listed.
